baseline_plan.title: Place object on chair seat
baseline_plan.summary: Put the small lightweight object onto the seat of the office chair to create an elevated resting surface.

steps.action: Place the small lightweight object onto the seat of the office chair.
steps.why_it_helps: The chair seat provides an elevated surface above the floor without needing additional items.

assumptions: The chair seat is clean and can support the lightweight object without damage.
The object is light enough not to deform or damage the chair seat.
unresolved_risks: The chair may roll or tip if disturbed, potentially causing the object to fall.
The object may slide off the seat if the chair moves or is tilted.
Exact height of the seat and slip resistance are unknown.
constraint_check: Use only listed physical inventory objects – satisfied (only office_chair_01 used).
Small lightweight object is an explicit external resource – satisfied.
Office chair must provide the resting surface – satisfied (seat used).
No table, shelf, box, stand, adhesive, tape, or unlisted furniture – satisfied.
Do not damage any listed object – assumed satisfied, but uncertainty noted.
Do not claim wheel locking, non-slip behavior, exact height, or resistance to disturbance – satisfied (no such claims made).

zero_initial_plan.title: Place object on office chair seat
zero_initial_plan.summary: Use the office chair's seat as an elevated surface to hold the small lightweight object above the floor without modifications.

steps.action: Place the small lightweight object onto the seat of the office chair.

capability_uses.purpose: hold the object on the chair seat

steps.why_it_helps: The chair seat provides a raised surface keeping the object off the floor.

findings.claim: The chair seat provides a raised surface keeping the object off the floor.
findings.explanation: The chair's DNA lacks traits or capabilities indicating its seat is elevated above floor; only support and elevate are listed.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove the claim about a raised surface, or justify elevation by using the chair's elevate capability to lift the object.

zero_final_plan.title: Raise chair seat then place object
zero_final_plan.summary: Adjust the office chair to a higher position using its elevate capability, then place the small lightweight object on the seat using its support capability.

steps.action: Adjust the office chair seat higher, then place the small lightweight object onto the seat.

capability_uses.purpose: raise the chair seat to be above floor
hold the object on the chair seat

steps.why_it_helps: Raising the seat creates an elevated surface; the chair then supports the object above the floor.
